label: spec.md worktree-aware path resolution (R3a)

tasks_completed.description: Add worktree-aware base-directory resolution to /spec Step 3
tasks_completed.changes: Inserted a new Step 3 sub-step 2 ('Resolve the spec base directory (worktree-aware)') that scans the parent's .claude/overnight-state-*.json files, reads each one's worktree_path field, and treats it as live when the path exists and is a directory. Modified the path-generation sub-step (now numbered 3) to write into <SPEC_BASE>/docs/dev/specs/ instead of the cwd-relative docs/dev/specs/. Renumbered the subsequent sub-steps from 3,4,5,6 to 4,5,6,7 (sequential integers per CLAUDE.md guidance).
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec Section 1 line 42 documents the failure mode: '/spec writes to docs/dev/specs/... relative to cwd; if invoked from parent before a worktree is created, the parent ends up with untracked files that later collide with the merge.' This was the exact root cause of the failed `/merge worktree-overnight-20260424-bfbc5f54` invocation that forced the manual workaround `mv docs/dev/specs docs/dev/specs.pre-merge-backup`. The detection convention mirrors `pretool-overnight-hook-guard.py:90-117` (`_extract_live_worktree_path` + `_get_active_worktree_paths`) so a single mental model governs both writers (this command) and guard (the hook).

edit_summary: Replaced original sub-step 2 (lines 39-43 of original 'Generate the output path') with two sub-steps: new sub-step 2 (worktree detection, ~33 lines of bash + prose at lines 39-71 of new file) and new sub-step 3 (path generation referencing $SPEC_BASE, lines 73-79 of new file).
Renumbered sub-steps 3,4,5,6 to 4,5,6,7 (lines 81-100 of new file).

blast_radius.note: spec.md is a command-prompt file; nothing 'imports' it in the source-code sense. Other commands reference its name in prose only. No code paths break.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Pre-existing latent gap (no commit introduced it; spec.md was authored without worktree awareness from the beginning). Surfaced concretely during the 2026-04-24 /merge worktree-overnight-20260424-bfbc5f54 failure documented in spec Section 1 line 42.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: spec.md was written before the worktree-based /dev-overnight workflow existed. The path generation (`docs/dev/specs/spec-<ts>.md`) is cwd-relative, so invoking /spec from the parent before a worktree is created — or while a worktree is active but cwd is still the parent — wrote untracked files into the parent. Those parent untracked files then collided with `/merge`'s working-tree state and forced the manual `mv docs/dev/specs docs/dev/specs.pre-merge-backup` workaround.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: By detecting any live overnight-state-*.json with a valid worktree_path and writing into that worktree, the spec lands inside the worktree's filesystem root. /merge then propagates it to the parent via the normal commit-merge path — no untracked-file collision. When no overnight is active, the existing default (write to parent) is preserved, so this is a strict superset of prior behavior.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: The fix is a markdown spec/prompt file, not code. The 103-line addition includes: (a) ~33 lines of bash for the detection logic — required by BA acceptance criterion AC3 (must scan overnight-state-*.json, read worktree_path, validate dir exists); (b) ~10 lines for the multi-active-worktree resolution case statement — explicitly mandated by the dispatch prompt ('if MORE than one overnight-state file is live, the spec command should ask the user (if interactive) OR use the most-recently-modified one'); (c) ~12 lines of explanatory prose tying the change back to the spec's session-proof failure mode (line 42 of spec Section 1) so future readers understand the why; (d) ~16 lines re-added from renumbering shift (the original sub-steps 3-6 had to be rewritten with new numbers 4-7). Net new behavior beyond renumbering ≈ 60 lines; cannot reasonably be smaller because all of (a), (b), (c) are explicit BA-spec requirements. No new functions/scripts/css-classes introduced (it's a prompt file).

dev.fix_layer: L4 (logic — adds new behavior to /spec command's path-resolution step)
qa_notes: AC3 verification: with .claude/overnight-state-<id>.json present in /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev/.claude/ containing a live worktree_path, invoking /spec from the parent should write into <worktree_path>/docs/dev/specs/spec-<ts>.md, NOT into /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev/docs/dev/specs/.

Default-behavior preservation: with no overnight-state-*.json present (or all of them stale/orphaned with non-existent worktree_path), /spec writes into the parent's docs/dev/specs/ — current behavior unchanged.

Multi-active-worktree behavior: if more than one overnight-state-*.json has a live worktree_path, the most-recently-modified one wins by default (find -printf %T@ + sort -zrn). User can override via CLAUDE_SPEC_WORKTREE env var. When stdin is a tty, an informational message is printed to stderr listing the candidates.
Step renumbering: Steps within Step 3 are now 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 (sequential integers; no decimal sub-numbering). Verify by visual inspection of lines 35-100 in /root/.claude/commands/spec.md.

External references to Step 3 sub-step indices: grep 'Step 3' in dev-overnight.md and other commands to verify nothing depended on the specific sub-step numbers (the prose body of those references uses 'Step 3' generically, not 'Step 3 sub-step 2', so renumbering is safe).
